scope: OpenRouter-specific controls compared with direct ArgoLink model contracts

openrouter.details: provider.order and provider preferences can order or constrain upstream providers; session stickiness can keep a conversation on a provider/model
openrouter.migration: choose a concrete model/base URL or implement an explicit fallback table

argolink.details: the model catalog is a provider API, not an OpenRouter-style cross-provider provider-order field
argolink.migration: keep routing policy in the calling gateway and use the model page for the selected ID

openrouter.details: reasoning controls and returned usage vary by model/provider
openrouter.migration: preserve an effort only when the destination model page names it

argolink.details: for example, GPT-6 Sol lists low, medium, high, xhigh, and max on the live catalog
argolink.migration: map the exact effort names and endpoint family from the model page

openrouter.details: provider prompt caching and OpenRouter response caching are separate; response caching is enabled by headers/presets and has endpoint/TTL rules
openrouter.migration: remove cache headers unless the destination documents equivalent semantics

argolink.details: no universal OpenRouter-compatible cache header contract is claimed in the checked model catalog
argolink.migration: use only the destination model's documented cached-token fields

openrouter.details: message transforms include context-compression plugins that change the input before routing
openrouter.migration: normalize or truncate explicitly in the client and record the change

argolink.details: no equivalent universal transform parameter is listed
argolink.migration: send the model's documented input shape without OpenRouter-only plugin fields

openrouter.migration: map the request fields and provider-documented status values; do not reuse a chat body

argolink.migration: map model-specific limits and persist request_id before polling

openrouter.details: provider/model response metadata and cached usage fields must be read from the response

argolink.details: record the response usage schema and effective catalog unit for the selected model
